verdicts.decision_note: The client requires RR-01 to be rendered consistently in every report location, establishing the RR01 footer-code rule for the document template.
The client explicitly sets the footer codes rendered in RR02, RR03, and RR04; the new keys extend the prior RR01 rule without making any existing key obsolete.
First concrete failure: the client observed that the RR02–RR04 footers displayed RR01 instead of their corresponding report codes.
Target-specific implementation claim after the first failure: the tightly bounded preceding request explicitly includes the RR02–RR04 footer-code corrections.
Post-claim persistence: the client observed that the RR02–RR04 footers still displayed RR-01 after the prior completion claim.
Renewed target-specific implementation claim after post-claim failure: the bounded correction request explicitly includes the outstanding footer-code changes.
